spec.title: Setup: build Solr core at both #3158 revisions and run the landed JSON facet tests
spec.description: Setup for case M05 (apache/solr#3158) of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/worktrees (M05-solr-fix = f66aa9ed, M05-solr-parent = c367cb75; Solr 10.0.0-SNAPSHOT on Lucene 9.12.1), runs the upstream ./gradlew (Gradle 8.10, wrapper jar 8.10.2 checked against services.gradle.org) on JDK 21.0.13 (Solr's wrapper wants 21-23) with the cache's GRADLE_USER_HOME: builds solr-core and runs the whole TestJsonFacets class (tests.seed=DEADBEEF) on the fix online, on the parent (its own copy) offline, on the parent with the fix's TestJsonFacets.java and schema_latest.xml copied in (expected to fail testMultivalueEnumTypes), and on the fix again offline. The setup could not run this test over its 9.8.0 overlay (main's test config does not start a core under the 9.8.0 test framework), so this job is the landed test's only run. Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: both sides' own TestJsonFacets pass, testMultivalueEnumTypes runs and passes on the fix and fails in the transplant

steps.name: M05-solr-fix: solr-core jar and the landed TestJsonFacets (online)
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs $O/artifacts; export JAVA_HOME=$J21; cd $W/M05-solr-fix; echo worktree=M05-solr-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); cp $O/dl/gradle/solr-gradle-wrapper-8.10.2.jar gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar; test $(sha256sum gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar | cut -c1-64) = $(cut -c1-64 gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar.sha256); rm -rf solr/core/build/test-results/test; set +e; ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false -Ptests.seed=DEADBEEF -Ptests.jvms=2 --max-workers=4  :solr:core:jar :solr:core:test --rerun --tests org.apache.solr.search.facet.TestJsonFacets > $O/logs/M05-fix.online.gradle-log.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; echo gradle-exit=$rc; tail -5 $O/logs/M05-fix.online.gradle-log.txt; python3 -I $O/scripts/junit_summary.py solr/core/build/test-results/test | tee $O/logs/M05-fix.online.junit.txt; grep -o 'testcase name="testMultivalueEnumTypes[^"]*"' solr/core/build/test-results/test/*.xml | sort | uniq -c || echo no-testMultivalueEnumTypes; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M05-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M05-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M05-fix.online.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; grep -q 'testcase name="testMultivalueEnumTypes' solr/core/build/test-results/test/*.xml; J=$(ls solr/core/build/libs/solr-core-*.jar | grep -v -E 'sources|javadoc|tests' | head -1); cp $J $O/artifacts/M05-solr-fix-core.jar; echo built-jar=$J; sha256sum $O/artifacts/M05-solr-fix-core.jar;
